### Included
- Interactive anatomical body visualization rendered with Canvas
- Toggleable layers:
  - Skin
  - Muscle tissue
  - Vascular network
  - Vital organs
  - Blood cells
- View modes:
  - Systems
  - X-Ray
  - Cellular
- Live simulation timeline with play/pause and speed controls
- Subject vitals panel:
  - Heart rate
  - Core temperature
  - Oxygen saturation
  - Blood pressure
  - Glucose
- Compound formulation system:
  - Caffeine
  - Isotonic saline
  - Adenosine
  - Dextrose
  - Heparin
- Drug formulation slots and formula preview
- Injection interaction that updates physiological readings and activates blood-cell visualization
- Educational simulation disclaimer
- Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile layouts
- Dark clinical laboratory UI with animated scanning and live anatomical overlays
